player_prompt.intro:
Inwe ni Jokwata {player_id} katika Nim.
Dhumo lako ni kikwere ogwedhi mwalo.
Katika kila wakati, tek gi pile moko na ondoa ogwedhi moko au gi makwongo.
Tumia mfumo wa '[pile quantity]', ambapo pile ni nambari ya pile na quantity ni nambari ya ogwedhi ondore.
Ka mfano, '[0 3]' ondoa ogwedhi 3 pile 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Onge fom mar dar ma ber. Ti kod '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Player {player_id}, Kitendo kisichowezekana. Safu {col} iko nje ya mipaka.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Pile index {pile_index} ok en e range.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Huwezi kuondoa {quantity} kutoka kundi {pile_index} (kuna {pile_count} tu zilizobaki).

observation.removed_from_piles: Player {player_id} alicheza [{pile_index} {quantity}], akiondoa {quantity} kitu (vit) kutoka kundi {pile_index}.

outcome.win: Jalo {player_id} nokawo gima ne otemo mogik!
